name: unitracka
description: UniTracka - platforma pentru gestionarea aplicatiilor la universitati.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.check: npm run check --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:e2e
